axes: sizes and boxes are in UNREAL axes: +X front, +Z up. Pivot = centre of the BODY footprint (the bounds of the collision hulls) on the ground (z = 0 = lowest point of the mesh). size_cm / bounds_*_cm are the whole render mesh INCLUDING loose debris and open doors, so they are not centred on the pivot; body_size_cm and footprint_half_extents_cm are the body only (hull bounds, centred on the pivot). Hull bounds are axis-aligned bounds of the hulls; hulls of tilted pieces (03, 04, 07, 15, 16) are rotated boxes. The FBX holds the Y-mirrored mesh on purpose: Unreal mirrors Y on FBX import, so the imported mesh matches this table (and the previews).
fbx: cm data, 0.01 unit-scale scene, FBX_SCALE_NONE, axis_forward X / axis_up Z, identity transforms; import with the LEGACY FBX importer (Interchange drops UCX), uniform scale 1, no mirroring in the map
uv1: unique lightmap rectangles (LightMapUV), authored for 128 px or more; small faces are only 2 px wide at 256
collision: UCX_<mesh>_<k>, k = 1..n, boxes (convex). Loose bits beside a piece (books, fallen drawer, broken legs, tiles) are not covered by a hull.
suggested_health_note: rough relative values by size and material (wood chair 30 .. tiled stove 350); tune freely
normal_map_convention: DirectX (green = -Y, Unreal default; leave "Flip Green Channel" OFF). Generated from the painted height field, not baked.

atlas_layout.type: 4 x 4 grid, 512 px cells, row 0 at the TOP of the image, cell index = row * 4 + col = piece number - 1

second_set.textures: none of its own: UV0 of every face lies inside an island that already exists in the atlas of pieces 01-16 (at least 2 px inside its edge). The three textures are unchanged.
second_set.atlas_cells_used: 1-based cell numbers = number of the first-set piece the region was painted for
second_set.tall_rule: tall = true when the piece reads as standing furniture or a fixed installation that belongs inside a building, whatever its height (17 toilet, 18 range, 19 sideboard, 22 sewing table, 23 gramophone, 25 hall stand, 26 cellar shelf, 28 display cabinet); false for pieces that lie flat or tipped over (20, 29, 31) and for things that belong in a yard or were carried into the street (21 pram, 24 trunk and cases, 27 wash tub and mangle, 30 barrel and crates, 32 hand cart)
second_set.sound_group: closest existing crush cue by material; sound_note says where nothing fits well
second_set.glass: the atlas has no glass: glazed doors are empty frames, the hall-stand mirror and the shards use the grey veined marble region
